queries.sql: SELECT u.user_id, u.email, u.email_verified, u.disabled, u.created_at, a."password", p."createdAt" AS provider_created_at FROM users u JOIN better_auth_users b ON b."id" = u.user_id AND b."email" = u.email JOIN better_auth_sessions p ON p."userId" = u.user_id JOIN sessions s ON s.session_id = p."id" AND s.user_id = u.user_id JOIN better_auth_accounts a ON a."userId" = u.user_id AND a."providerId" = 'credential' WHERE p."token" = $1 AND s.token_digest = $2 AND ($3::text IS NULL OR s.session_id = $3) AND s.surface = 'site' AND s.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND p."expiresAt" > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND s.issued_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND p."createdAt" <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND b."emailVerified" = true AND u.email_verified = true AND u.disabled = false FOR UPDATE OF u, b, p, s, a
